# Mesta Media

> Mesta Media is Brandi Mesta’s independent business development and brand partnerships consultancy for media, events, and marketing businesses.

Services include business development support, partnership and account growth, B2B positioning and sales materials, and practical AI and digital support. Brandi works across niche, highly regulated, and mainstream markets.

- [Mesta Media](https://mestamedia.com/index.html.md): Business overview, capabilities, founder background, and contact information.

- [How I Think](https://mestamedia.com/how-i-think/index.html.md): Approach to business development, partnerships, and practical execution.
